 30+ Halloween Events for Metro Detroit Families THIS Weekend (October 29 – 31)
 By: LittleGuide Detroit
 on
 October 25, 2026
 It’s Halloween week and there are a lot of places to celebrate beyond your neighborhood ! From trick-or-treating and fall festivals to haunted trails, glowing adventures, costume parties + FREE Halloween fun, we found over 30 family-friendly Halloween events happening across Metro Detroit October 29 – 31, 2026.
 Grab the costumes + start planning – here’s where to find the BEST Halloween fun happening THIS weekend!
 Thursday, October 29
 Halloween Toddler Storytime @ Library (Southgate) 
 Trunk or Treat @ HYPE Athletics (Dearborn Heights) 
 Movie Under the Stars: Hocus Pocus @ Recreation Center (Hazel Park) 
 Healthy Halloween Fair and Trunk-or-Treat @ Mercy Education Project (Detroit) 
 Boo Bash @ Briarwood Mall (Ann Arbor) 
 Brick or Treat @ LEGOLAND Discovery Center (Auburn Hills) 
 Hallowe’en @ Greenfield Village (Dearborn) 
 CarnEvil 2 @ Glenlore Trails (Commerce) 
 Ooky Spooky Light Show @ Longway Planetarium (Flint)
